notes.ramp: The ground's height above LAT (metres) to colour, linear between the stops: the chart's blues under the lowest tide; across the tide's reach aqua at low water through pale green and straw to sand at high water; above the tides a grey buff darkening uphill, so the beach stands out from the fields behind it. The index carries the stops, and the map's key draws its scale from them, so the key always matches the tiles it describes.
notes.maxzoom: z14 with 512 px tiles is about 2.9 m a pixel at 53 N: the 2 m LiDAR at about its own detail (the map's own max zoom is 14). Under z11 a z11 tile's grid is all there is, so z9-z10 are overviews (the mean of the heights under each pixel), shaded at their own scale.
notes.minzoom: Under z9 the areas are a few pixels across: the coverage's outline (coverage.json) marks them at every zoom instead.
notes.priority: Sources in this order: a pixel takes the first that has it. The bathymetric surveys first: flown for the shore and the seabed, in LAT, and through shallow water; a topographic flight over water sees only its surface.
notes.datum: A LiDAR on a land datum (MALIN: OD Malin; BELFAST: OD Belfast) is brought to the LAT of each pixel's tide station (scripts/foildepth/stations.json, odMalinOffsetMetres / odBelfastOffsetMetres; the nearest, or the basin whose polygon it is in, as the foil layer's regions), decided per stationBlockPixels block and interpolated between the blocks' centres, so no station's edge draws a step.
notes.hillshade: Lit from the north-west (azimuth) at altitude degrees, heights times exaggeration at z14 and perZoom more at each zoom out (the slopes flatten as pixels grow). strength is how much of the colour the shade takes: flat ground keeps its colour exactly.
notes.scale: OSNI's Bangor extension (2012) is in millimetres: against the 2007 Bangor flight where both are, 998.8 times its heights (5-95%: 990.7-1004.8), within 3 cm once scaled.
notes.coverage: The outline is each source's valid cells at coverageCellMetres, closed by a cell, holes and pieces under coverageMinKm2 dropped, simplified to coverageSimplifyMetres.
